    Rotation & substitutions

    Click a player, then another to swap them.
    PlayerEnergy (%)PFPts
    Click a player, then another. Two on court or two on the bench swap positions; one on court and one on the bench is a substitution (applied at the next dead ball).

    Offense

    Player shot locations

    Choose each player's first, second and third preferred scoring spot. Higher-rated players win contested spots; players then try their next choice. Changes apply to this game from the next possession; use Defaults to save them.

    Defense

    Choose which of your on-court players guards each opponent. Check Double team to send a second defender when that opponent has the ball.
    Four defenders hold the box; the selected defender follows this opponent everywhere.

    Coaching defaults

    Save the offense, defense, tempo, pressure, coverage, rebounding and auto-sub settings above as your defaults, so every future game starts with them. Change them again any time, for example after finding a better system mid-season.
